set.body: Phase 1 review finding 4 of 8. R/pairing.R currently accepts self-pairs and mixtures of self and cross pairs without an explicit bias or independence policy. Individually finite extreme weights can overflow during sum(weight), producing all-zero normalized weights, and pairing_marginals() trusts mutable class-tagged data including negative mutated weights. Specify self-pair and independence semantics, revalidate pairing objects at use sites, and use overflow-safe positive normalization with a finite positive normalized sum. Done when self/cross policy, extreme weights, forged objects, and post-construction mutations have adversarial tests while undirected endpoint invariance remains intact.
set.title: Harden pairing domains and normalized-weight arithmetic
